segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I pulled up the renewal in the CRM. You’re at 42 seats today, contract ends March 31, and the current annual is $38,640. I wanted to confirm the seat count before I send the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That sounds right, mostly. We have 42 active, but finance asked me to add 6 more for the operations team, so 48 total starting April 1.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay, 48 seats. At the current tier, that puts the annual at $44,160 before any discount. Since this is a renewal with expansion, I can apply the 8% renewal discount from the pricing sheet, which brings it to $40,627.20.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. Can you do net 45 on the invoice? Our standard process is net 45 unless legal pushes back.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, net 45 is fine for your account. I’ll note that for billing. Same billing contact as last year, ap at northlineparts dot com?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, same inbox. Please also copy me on the first invoice because last year it got routed weirdly and I had to chase it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. For the term, are you staying with 12 months, April 1, 2026 through March 31, 2027?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes. And we need the 6 new users live by April 8. Is that realistic if we sign by next Friday?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, if we have signature by March 14, implementation can add the seats the same day and your admin can assign them. No professional services needed unless you want help with permissions.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, we can handle permissions. Send the order form and the updated quote, and I’ll route it today.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Great. I’ll send it over in the next hour with 48 seats, 12-month term, net 45, billing copy to you, and the 8% renewal discount. If anything changes in legal, just reply on the thread.
